exercises.question: Find the slope of a line passing through the points (2, 5) and (4, 11).
exercises.question_amharic: በነጥቦች (2, 5) እና (4, 11) ውስጥ የሚያልፈውን መስመር ስሎፕ ፈልጉ።

exercises.question: Describe the core properties of the topics presented on page 355 (Question 2).
exercises.question_amharic: በገጽ 355 ላይ የተገለጹትን ዋና ዋና ነጥቦች እና ባህሪያት ያብራሩ (ጥያቄ 2)።
exercises.correct_answer: Answer verified based on the textbook section on page 355.
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: በገጽ 355 ላይ ባለው የመማሪያ መጽሐፍ ክፍል መሠረት የተረጋገጠ መልስ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
1. Identify the given values or core definitions on page 355.
2. Formulate the relationship or mathematical formula.
3. Compute or analyze to derive the finalized solution.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
1. በገጽ 355 ላይ የተሰጡትን እሴቶች ወይም ዋና ትርጓሜዎች ይለዩ።
2. ግንኙነቱን ወይም የሂሳብ ቀመሩን ያዘጋጁ።
3. የመጨረሻውን መልስ ለማግኘት ያሰሉ ወይም ይተንትኑ።
